CódigoEcrãDefinição
TAXTax ID numberTax ID number
HCHealth Card NumberHealth Card Number
BRBirth registry numberAn identifier unique within the Assigning Authority that is the official legal record of a person's birth.
RIResource identifierA generalized resource identifier.
RPHPharmacist license numberAn identifier that is unique to a pharmacist within the jurisdiction of the licensing board.
DDSDentist license numberAn identifier that is unique to a dentist within the jurisdiction of the licensing board
MDMedical License numberAn identifier that is unique to a medical doctor within the jurisdiction of a licensing board.
INDIndigenous/AboriginalA number assigned to a member of an indigenous or aboriginal group outside of Canada.
BCTBirth CertificateA number associated with a document identifying the event of a person's birth
DLDriver's license numberDriver's license number
SSSocial Security numberSocial Security number
RNRegistered Nurse NumberAn identifier that is unique to a registered nurse within the jurisdiction of the licensing board.
PPNPassport numberA unique number assigned to the document affirming that a person is a citizen of the country.
MCTMarriage CertificateA number associated with a document identifying the event of a person's marriage.
RRIRegional registry IDRegional registry ID
MIMilitary ID numberA number assigned to an individual who has had military duty, but is not currently on active duty. The number is assigned by the DOD or Veterans' Affairs (VA).
